Prince William Plays Cricket in London, Earthshot Prize to Visit India

Prince William participated in a game of cricket outside Buckingham Palace in London. He was described as a "pretty good" batsman by Joe Root. The Earthshot Prize, an initiative led by Prince William, is set to be held in India.
